title: Emergency Rain Jacket – Lightweight & Packable Rain Protection
descriptionHtml:
Never get caught off guard by the rain again

The weather can turn fast on the hike or at the festival. Without rain protection you end up soaked and cold within minutes.

Light enough to always bring along

This rain jacket weighs almost nothing and fits in your pocket or backpack. When the rain comes, you pull it out and stay dry right away.

Features

  • Lightweight and packable – fits in your pocket
  • Waterproof material
  • Great as emergency gear in your backpack
  • For hiking, festivals and camping
  • Comes as a multipack

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
